Other Relevant Information
Dr. Karen Oberthaler is a board-certified veterinary oncologist and a diplomate of the American College of Internal Medicine in Oncology.    Dr. Oberthaler graduated magna cum laude from the School of Veterinary Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania in 2002. Following graduation she completed an internship at the Animal Medical Center in New York City in 2003.
